keySentence: A little pig met new friends.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Soon another friend arrived. Daisy the calf had brown spots. She gave Pip a soft nudge. Then Gigi the goose flapped over. She had bright orange feet. Last came Penny the red hen. She clucked a happy welcome. A little pig met new friends.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: One by one, the other animals came over to meet Pip. First, Daisy the spotted calf walked up slowly, her big brown eyes kind and curious. She nuzzled his shoulder gently and lowed a soft hello. Then Gigi the white goose came flapping across the yard, her orange feet slapping the dirt happily. "Welcome, little one!" she honked, spreading her wings wide. Last of all, Penny the reddish hen pecked her way closer. She clucked happily and circled around him, looking him up and down with kind eyes. Pip's tiny pink eyes grew wide as he realized he now had four kind new friends, all in one morning. A little pig met new friends, and his world grew bigger.
facts.Word cards: pig = 돼지 / farm = 농장 / meet = 만나다 / welcome = 환영하다
